cards.snippet: (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.)

cards.card_text: In Christ Jesus, Paul says neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value.

cards.card_text: Paul asks the brothers why he's still being persecuted if he's still preaching circumcision.

cards.snippet: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted?

cards.card_text: Then Paul takes the whole circumcision question and settles it in one line.
cards.verse_text: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything.
